request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 2000 sets of hex key set. The most we are willing to pay: USD 1.16 per sets (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Santos. Logo printing: no. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Redwood Outdoor Gear
Supplier message:
Dear friend,
Thanks for your inquiry about the hex key set.
Unit price 1.45 USD (FOB Ningbo).
Minimum order 300 sets.
Lead time 45 days.
Payment terms 30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment.
Looking forward to your order.
Kind regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":1.45,"currency":"USD","moq":300,"moq_unit":"sets","lead_time_days":45,"incoterm":"FOB","payment_terms":"30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment"}}

text:
{"reply": "Dear Redwood Outdoor Gear team,

Thank you for your quotation. Your price of USD 1.45 per set is above what we can accept for this order.

We can offer USD 1.16 per set, FOB Ningbo, for 2000 sets. No logo printing is required; the sets will be packed in export cartons.

To finalize our evaluation, please confirm the following:
1. Whether USD 1.16 per set is acceptable to you.
2. The shipping terms and freight arrangement to Santos, Brazil, if you can quote them.
3. Confirmation that a 2000-set order can be produced within your stated 45-day lead time.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards"}
